<parameter=code>
def blue_tl(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']==15:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
    return None
def plus_present(f):
    return any(n['color']=='W' for n in f.segmentation['nodes'])
print("start", blue_tl(current_frame), "plus", plus_present(current_frame))
seq=['DOWN','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN']
prev=blue_tl(current_frame)
for d in seq:
    action([d])
    res=last_action_result
    cur=blue_tl(current_frame)
    print(d, "tl", cur, "moved", cur!=prev, "plus", plus_present(current_frame),
          "done",res.get('done'),"lc",res.get('level_completed'),"go",res.get('game_over'))
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'): break
    if cur==prev: print("  BLOCKED"); break
    prev=cur
print("final", blue_tl(current_frame), "plus", plus_present(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
